invariants: I-001 one logical command identity executes exactly once and saves its result
I-002 exact replay returns the same result and does not execute the effect
I-003 same idempotency key with different fingerprint/payload is a CONFLICT
I-004 same idempotency key from a different identity is a CONFLICT
I-005 same idempotency key in a different tenant context is a CONFLICT
I-006 Authorization DENY or dependency failure does not create an idempotency record and no effect is executed
I-007 idempotency guard creates no second identity or tenant mechanism
I-008 cross-tenant or cross-identity replays are security-sensitive and audited

operations.authorization_operation: none (enforced by the wrapping business service)

events.note: Idempotency guard publishes no external events.

data_export_cdc.note: Idempotency state is transient and internal. No CDC.

datasets.name: idempotency_records
datasets.note: Transient storage mapping idempotency_key to execution results

authz.note: Idempotency guard executes AFTER the authorization decision. It relies on the wrapping service for authorization.
